information: If you would like to be on the competitor list, please carefully note exactly when registration opens, and sign up as soon as possible. This competition has filled up very quickly in the past, so do not miss out. Please see tabs for more information. Complimentary pizza will be offered during the competition. NEW POLICY: Princeton University now requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 that plans to compete must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to sign in. (Please reach out to the organizer with any issues/questions.)
